S3-1.note: The result carries an authorization field that always says no decision is made here.

S4-1.reason: Addressed to the authorization system (whether it requires an EQR at all). The reader claims no qualification when the context says no PASS EQR is required.

S5-1.note: Local JSON values are hashed over their RFC 8785 bytes; non-JSON values over their exact bytes.

S5-2.reason: Addressed to profile authors. The reader takes the canonical bytes a profile defines as its input (text or exact bytes) and hashes them unchanged.

S5.1-4.finding: Whether a receipt whose evaluation members contradict each other is invalid or only non-qualifying
readings: (a) INVALID receipt: the issuer broke a MUST of Section 5.1, so the receipt is malformed
(b) VALID receipt that does not qualify: Section 8.1 tests requirements_satisfied and blocking_contradictions on their own
S5.1-4.implemented: (a): pass with unsatisfied requirements or a blocking contradiction, fail or indeterminate with every requirement satisfied are refused as INVALID
S5.1-4.why: The pseudo-code of 8.1 checks the members separately, which reads as if a pass with unsatisfied requirements were a valid receipt; Table 1 has no row for an internally inconsistent receipt.

S5.1-5.finding: How a verifier learns that a profile's required-condition set is empty
readings: (a) from the accepted local profile, which states its required conditions
(b) not at all: the rule binds only the issuer
S5.1-5.implemented: (a): the accepted profile entry states required_conditions as a count; pass under a count of zero is INVALID. A pass with no evidence descriptor does not qualify either.
S5.1-5.why: The profile format is not defined by the draft, so a verifier cannot read the set from the profile digest; only its local copy of the profile can tell.

S6-1.note: The mechanism accepted here is JWS compact with EdDSA over Ed25519, keys from the trust configuration only; whether a receipt is inter-domain is local policy (default: yes).

S7-2.reason: Addressed to profile authors (what a profile states). The reader treats profile bytes as opaque and checks only their digest.

S7-3.reason: Addressed to profile authors (comparison space, units, bridge, tolerance).

S7-4.note: Seen by a verifier only across receipts: one receipt id with two contents is refused.

S8-1.finding: Which members an EQR must carry and in which form
readings: (a) every member Section 5 does not call optional is required, with the member names and types of the example in Section 5.2
(b) only the members Section 8 uses are required, other names and types are allowed
S8-1.implemented: (a): version (the string 1), receipt_id, issuer, issued_at, expires_at, profile and claim (id, hash_alg, digest), evaluation (status, requirements_satisfied, blocking_contradictions) and evidence are required; context_digest, action_digest, supersedes (also null) and nonce are optional; other members are kept and never read as a verdict
S8-1.why: Section 5 names objects by their content ("a stable profile identifier and digest") and only the example gives member names; it does not say which members a receipt may omit.

S10-3.finding: Whether a receipt superseded by a valid successor can still satisfy a PASS requirement
readings: (a) it stays valid history and no longer qualifies
(b) it qualifies until it expires; supersession only adds history
S10-3.implemented: (a); an invalid successor does not supersede, and a predecessor that is not presented is reported, not taken as deleted
S10-3.why: Section 10 forbids treating supersession as deletion but does not say what a superseded PASS is worth to a policy; Section 15 warns against replaying a PASS after its evidence changed.

S15-2.finding: Whether an evidence descriptor past its fresh_until keeps a receipt from qualifying
readings: (a) yes: a descriptor stale at verification time keeps the receipt from qualifying
(b) no: fresh_until is local metadata; only expires_at bounds the receipt
S15-2.implemented: (a); a nonce is checked only against an expected value, a validity interval only against a local bound
S15-2.why: Section 5 calls freshness on a descriptor local metadata, while Section 15 names a PASS replayed after the evidence became stale as unsafe.

S15-4.note: The package imports no network module; tests/check_no_network.py holds that.

S16-1.reason: Privacy practice for deployments, not a verifier behaviour.
